title: Car insurance policy (2025 Honda Civic)
text: Policy number MS-448210. Covers the 2025 Honda Civic. Annual premium is $1,860, paid monthly at $155. Deductible is $500 for collision and $300 for comprehensive. Roadside assistance is included. The policy renews on November 14, 2026. To cancel, give 30 days written notice.

title: Dishwasher extended warranty
text: Extended warranty for the Bosch 300 Series dishwasher, serial SHE53C85N. Covers parts and labour for mechanical and electrical failures. Does not cover cosmetic damage or damage from improper installation. Coverage ends October 29, 2026. To make a claim, call 1-800-555-0142 with the serial number and proof of purchase.

title: Apartment lease, Unit 304

key_dates.label: Notice to leave or renew due

text: Fixed-term lease for Unit 304 from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027. Monthly rent is $1,950, due on the first of each month. Heat and water are included; electricity is not. One small pet is allowed with a $300 pet deposit. Tenant must give three months written notice before the end of the term to leave or renew.

title: Internet bill, September 2026
text: Fibre 500 plan. Amount due $85.00 by October 15, 2026. The promotional rate of $85 per month ends December 1, 2026, after which the regular rate is $110 per month. Wi-Fi network name is Unit304-Home.

title: Passport
text: Canadian passport, 10-year validity. Expires February 20, 2027. Many countries require at least six months of validity remaining to enter, so travel after August 20, 2026 may need a renewed passport. Simplified renewal is available if the current passport was issued in the last 15 years.
